reason: I like the filters and application tracking, but I would keep checking job posts and deadlines in the original places until I knew the listings were current. Docker feels like a lot of setup for something I can do with a spreadsheet.
objection: How can I tell whether a listing is still open and when the source last refreshed?
would_change_my_mind: A quick demo with visible source and refresh dates, plus a guided setup I can finish on my laptop without help.
